title: Russian-Style Beef Pilaf
description: A hearty, comforting dish with tender beef and flavorful pilaf. Perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and cook until browned.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking into small pieces.
Stir in pilaf mix, beef broth, salt, pepper, and thyme.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot.
Serve with additional beef broth, if desired.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
